item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Hitesh's coil of insulated copper wire wound on an iron nail and joined to a cell. Steel paper clips cling to the nail tip.

Which claim about this arrangement is correct?

options.A: The nail stays strongly magnetic and keeps holding the clips after the current is switched off.
options.B: The iron nail core makes the electromagnet weaker than the coil alone.
options.C: The current-carrying coil acts as a temporary magnet, and the iron nail core makes it stronger.
options.D: Without any current, the coil alone still acts as a strong permanent magnet.
